data.body: S1 PS2 review: LLM-Review+1 PASS. 2 advisory (test-quality) findings: (1) corpus parity test tautological (both operands same parse_structured call); (2) guard __cause__ identity contract untested. Both fixed test-only in PS3: corpus test now asserts independent expected _Verdict(verdict=PASS) + parity; added test_guard_retryable_error_preserves_exact_cause and test_guard_unretryable_error_is_not_wrapped (direct on after_model_request). Oracle now 20 GREEN, lint clean. pai_output.py unchanged. Pushed PS3 to change 1834. PS2 CI was green on lint+typecheck+py3.11+py3.12 (py3.13 in-flight, superseded). Awaiting PS3 gates.
